hero.title: Marina Cole
hero.tagline: Vocalist performing jazz and soul across London and the UK.

about.label: About
about.p1: A London-based jazz and soul vocalist with over a decade performing in some of the city's most respected rooms. Her voice moves comfortably across the Great American Songbook, contemporary jazz standards and soul classics, a repertoire broad enough to suit any room, always delivered with the same attention.
about.p2: She performs solo with piano accompaniment, as a duo with guitar or with her full quartet, and has built a reputation for sets that feel tailored rather than rehearsed. Every booking begins with a conversation about the evening, the space, the guests, the atmosphere. The music follows from there and forward.

testimonials.quote: “Marina brings a rare warmth to every performance, our audience is captivated from the first note. She's become a favourite at the club.”

testimonials.quote: “Marina is incredibly professional and adaptable to any setting. She elevated our corporate event and left a lasting impression on every guest.”
